exercises.title: Finish each of the following sentences in such a way that it means exactly the same as the sentence printed.

questions.stem: ‘Why don’t you put a better lock on the door, Barry?’, said John.

answers.correct: John suggested *that Barry should put a better lock on door.
alternatives: to Barry that he should put

questions.explanation: Đáp án gốc trong sách: John suggested *that Barry should put (to Barry that he should put) a better lock on door.*

questions.stem: Although both his legs were broken in the crash, he managed to get out of the car before it exploded. Despite his

answers.correct: Despite his two broken legs in the crash, he managed to get out...

questions.explanation: Đáp án gốc trong sách: Despite his two broken legs (both his legs being broken) in the crash, he managed to get out...

questions.stem: I haven’t eaten this kind of food before.

answers.correct: This is the first time I’ve eaten this kind of food.

questions.explanation: Đáp án gốc trong sách: This is the first time I’ve eaten this kind of food.

questions.stem: After fighting the fire for twelve hours, the firemen succeeded in putting it out.

answers.correct: The firemen managed *to put the fire out after fighting it for 12 hours.

questions.explanation: Đáp án gốc trong sách: The firemen managed *to put the fire out (to put out the fire) after fighting it for 12 hours.*

questions.stem: The architect has drawn plans for an extension to the house.

answers.correct: Plans for an extension to the house have been drawn by the architect.

questions.explanation: Đáp án gốc trong sách: Plans for an extension to the house have been drawn by the architect.

questions.stem: In Stratford-on-Avon, we saw Shakespeare’s birthplace.

answers.correct: We saw the house in Stratford on Avon *where* Shakespeare was born.

questions.explanation: Đáp án gốc trong sách: We saw the house in Stratford on Avon *where (in which)* Shakespeare was born.

questions.stem: It isn’t necessary for you to finish by Saturday.

answers.correct: You don’t *need to finish* by Saturday.

questions.explanation: Đáp án gốc trong sách: You don’t *need to finish* (*don’t have to finish*) by Saturday.

questions.stem: ‘How many survivors are there?’ asked the journalist.

answers.correct: The journalist wanted to know *how many survivors there were.

questions.explanation: Đáp án gốc trong sách: The journalist wanted to know *how many survivors there were (the number of survivors).*

questions.stem: It was such rotten meat that it had to be thrown away.

answers.correct: The meat was so rotten that it had to be thrown away.

questions.explanation: Đáp án gốc trong sách: The meat was so rotten that it had to be thrown away.

questions.stem: It is essential that Professor Van Helsing is met at the airport.

answers.correct: Professor Van Helsing *must* be met at the airport.

questions.explanation: Đáp án gốc trong sách: Professor Van Helsing *must (has to)* be met at the airport.

questions.stem: You can’t visit the United States unless you get a visa.

answers.correct: If you don’t get ** a visa, you can’t visit the United States.

questions.explanation: Đáp án gốc trong sách: If you don’t get *(haven’t got)* a visa, you can’t visit the United States.

questions.stem: ‘Can I borrow your typewriter, Janet?’ asked Peter.

answers.correct: Peter asked if *he could borrow Janet’s* typewriter.

questions.explanation: Đáp án gốc trong sách: Peter asked if *he could borrow (Janet could lend him) Janet’s (her)* typewriter.
